answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive overview of **Mundra Port**:

---

### 🚢 Mundra Port — Overview

**Location & Type:**
Mundra Port is the **largest commercial and container port in India**, located on the northern shores of the Gulf of Kutch near Mundra, Kutch district, **Gujarat**.

It is **India's first private port**, formerly operated by Mundra Port and Special Economic Zone Limited (MPSEZ) under the ownership of the **Adani Group**. It was later expanded to become **Adani Ports & SEZ Limited (APSEZ)**, managing several port projects.

---

### 📦 Cargo & Capacity

The port has been designed to handle all types of cargo — **containers, dry bulk, break bulk, liquid cargo, and automobiles**.

Mundra Port has a capacity to handle **338 MMT of cargo per annum** — the largest amongst all operational ports in India.

The port currently handles over **155 MT**, the highest in India, constituting nearly 11% of India's total annual maritime cargo, and handles nearly **33% of India's container traffic**.

---

### 🏗️ Infrastructure

Mundra Port operates **26 berths** across multiple specialized terminals with a total capacity of 228 MMTPA. The facility includes four container terminals handling 7.5 million TEUs annually, equipped with deep-water berths up to **19 meters draft**.

Key infrastructure comprises an automated liquid terminal with 97 tanks storing 464,000 KL, dedicated coal and bulk cargo terminals, and automobile handling facilities.

---

### 🌐 Connectivity & Trade

Mundra Port in Gujarat offers direct connectivity to major global markets including the **US East Coast, Europe, Middle East, and Africa**. It is linked to the national rail and highway networks, efficiently serving North and Northwest India's industrial and agricultural regions.

The port is served by all major global shipping lines, including **Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM, Hapag-Lloyd, COSCO, and Evergreen**.

---

### 🏭 Special Economic Zone (SEZ)

The Port of Mundra is not just a private port — it is also a **Special Economic Zone (SEZ)**. It became India's **first multi-product port-based special economic zone**.

---

### 📈 Global Standing

Mundra Port is ranked **among the top 30 busiest container ports globally**.

In summary, Mundra Port is a **major deep-draft, all-weather, private commercial seaport** in Gujarat, India, operated by the Adani Group, and serves as India's largest and most strategic maritime trade gateway.
